name: EESystem session – 60 minutes
description: An hour in the session room, which is equipped with the EESystem. You stay clothed, in an armchair, on a lounger or on the sofa, and spend the slot as you like: you read, listen to something on headphones or sit with your eyes closed. You can come on your own or in a small group. On your first visit, a member of the team shows you around in a few minutes.
whatsappMessage: Hello! I would like to book an appointment. Service: EESystem session – 60 minutes.
